text:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming-tail-p99 breaching 15s in eu-west-1 for /v1/stream (p95=1.2s p99=18.7s) — paging oncall

Jonah (oncall): acked, paging in. grabbing logs + timeline.

Maria (sre): saw the alert, looking at proxy pool in eu-west-1. early signs of long write latency on streaming-proxy-3 (write stalls ~10-30s).

Samira (eng-runtime): noted recent small deploy to streaming-proxy image last hour? any rollouts?

Jonah (oncall): there was a config tweak earlier to outbound keepalive, but that was only for canary. will check deploys.

Maria (sre): quick check: proxy health shows 20% of conns on streaming-proxy-3 in WAIT_WRITE. backend (runtime) shows no backlog, KV cache ok. ingress ALB 504s spiking for streaming endpoints.

Liam (support): multiple customers reporting stalled live responses and socket disconnects, ticket count rising. Customer A and B hit repeatedly.

Samira (eng-runtime): can we confirm if this is client backpressure (slow reads) vs proxy flush? tail latency suggests write stalls on the proxy tier. pull `ss` on proxy host?

Maria (sre): running quick `grep` on logs, seeing repeated `EPIPE` vs `write timeout` logs around 1785554200-1785554300. Also a few `proxy buffer full` warnings.

Jonah (oncall): @Samira can you roll proxy logs for connection detail? `curl http://proxy/metrics | jq .stream_conn_states` maybe.

Samira (eng-runtime): pulled metrics — per-conn write queue depth up, mostly connections with large initial prefix and slow client drain. Looks like an influx of long-lived clients holding slots.

Jonah (oncall): hypothesis: slow consumers at edge (clients) causing proxy to buffer, exhausting proxy write buffers and delaying other streams => tail spikes. We need to reduce per-conn buffer or enable backpressure shedding.

Maria (sre): mitigation options: 1) bump ALB idle timeout lower so stuck connections die earlier (risk: customer disconnects). 2) enable proxy per-conn max-buffer  (fast to flip for canary then scale). 3) scale out proxy pool to absorb backlog.

Liam (support): customers prefer graceful mitigation, not mass disconnects. Can we do 2 + 3 first?

Samira (eng-runtime): I'm pushing a canary to enable `streaming.conn_max_buffer=64KB` on eu-west canary hosts now. command:

```bash
kubectl set env deployment/streaming-proxy streaming_conn_max_buffer=65536 -n infra-eu-west
kubectl rollout status deployment/streaming-proxy -n infra-eu-west
```

Maria (sre): scaling proxies up by 2 replicas in eu-west now (quick patch):

```bash
kubectl scale deployment/streaming-proxy --replicas=6 -n infra-eu-west
```

Jonah (oncall): applying the buffer limit to canary (thanks). watching p99. setting 15m watch.

incident-bot: ACTION: Pager duty alert rerouted to Jonah (oncall) and Maria (sre) — incident active — severity: seve-2 — contact list updated.

Samira (eng-runtime): canary shows immediate drop in per-conn buffer usage for those pods, and write queue depth down ~30% for canary traffic. p99 for canary subset ~2.1s.

Maria (sre): global p99 trending down from 18.7s -> 8.3s after canary + scale, but still above SLO. likely need wider roll.

Jonah (oncall): plan: rollout conn_max_buffer=64KB to eu-west fully over 5m, continue scale. Avoid ALB timeout change unless we hit persistent stuck conns.

Ana (product): any customer-visible message we should send? ETA for mitigation?

Liam (support): tell customers: investigating streaming stalls, partial mitigation in progress, expected improvement within 10-15 minutes. I'll craft message.

Samira (eng-runtime): rolling to remaining eu-west proxies now: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/streaming-proxy -n infra-eu-west` with env var preserved.

Maria (sre): watch: p99 now 5.4s, p95 1.3s. ALBs still show a small % 504s but trending down.

Jonah (oncall): good. start collecting root cause evidence: attach proxy thread dumps + `strace` on victim hosts? Maria, can you capture `tcpdump` for one problematic host for 2m?

Maria (sre): grabbing tcpdump on streaming-proxy-3: `sudo tcpdump -w /tmp/stream-proxy3.pcap port 443 and host <client-ip>`. also saving `journalctl -u streaming-proxy -o short-iso > /tmp/proxy.log`.

Samira (eng-runtime): aside: runtime reported several retries upstream ~1785554250 when proxy attempted to push partial chunks; it's likely proxy-side buffering + client slowness causing repeated re-transmits and timeouts.

Jonah (oncall): current status: mitigation rolled, replicas increased, p99 improving. customer impact reduced but some users still see reconnects. Handoff in 20m to next oncall if stable.

incident-bot: STATUS_CHANGE: mitigated -> partial-mitigated at 1785554410 — followup investigation required.

Maria (sre): action items for postmortem: - full postmortem capturing config change history (who changed keepalive), - add metric for per-conn buffer usage and slow-consumer ratio, - automation to auto-shed slow clients under pressure.

Samira (eng-runtime): I'll open PR to add per-route shedding and a circuit to prefer short-lived connections under backpressure.

Liam (support): customer messages queued; will send short update in 10 min.

Jonah (oncall): handing off to next oncall @Maria in 20m if stable. leaving runbook notes: keep an eye on p99 and ALB 504s, don't change ALB idle timeout unless instructed by infra lead.

Maria (sre): ack handoff. will continue monitoring and collect artifacts for postmortem.

Ana (product): thanks team. please tag any customer tickets once the message is posted so CS can close.

Jonah (oncall): closing active page for me, leaving the incident thread. last check p99=2.9s p95=1.2s. will follow up in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
